failures.script: selftest.mjs (fixtures of watch, status, handover, commit, harvest, fsck)
failures.what: selftest run (full) exits 1 on the static check no-fixtures: watch, status, handover, commit, harvest and fsck have no good and no bad case.json, so no case runs and no passing selftest line can be written. Admission (admit.mjs selftest-missing/selftest-fail/selftest-stale) therefore refuses every start in a real run until they exist.
failures.likely_cause: The fixture folders of units U1b (watch, status, handover) and U2a (commit, harvest, fsck) hold only _-prefixed test data (for example fixtures/watch/_split-call-a.jsonl), never a case.json in the selftest's fixture-case format; the fixture work for those six scripts was not done. Evidence: find tcb/fixtures -name case.json gives 85 cases over 18 scripts; run --only <script> passes for all 18.

failures.what: harvest exits 1 some-invalid {invalid 0, unparseable 1} on a normal session whose Agent call returned a prose result. The two valid cards were written and a repeat is idempotent, but the exit is a failure, and watch's intake and any gate that reads exit 1 see it every turn.
failures.likely_cause: harvest.mjs lines ~158-180 count every Agent/Task result text that is not JSON and shorter than 2,000 characters as a candidate and as unparseable. spec/harvest.mjs.md says only a tool result 'whose whole text parses as JSON' is a candidate, so a prose result should be skipped. Either the code should skip non-JSON text or the spec must say that prose counts; the former matches the stated intent.

failures.what: gate check answered p-id-missing for G1..G12 when the hazards object covered P1..P21 as the spec and the contract say. The code also requires the twelve gap rows G1..G12 in some hazard's p_ids.
failures.likely_cause: Review finding U5-GT-1 (design R55: gaps G1-G12 are problem rows) was fixed in gate.mjs (line ~349) but not carried into spec/gate.mjs.md or the contract; a mapper brief that follows the spec would never pass the gate. Not a code defect; the documents and the mapper brief need the G ids named. The e2e then listed both ranges and the gate passed.

failures.what: tcb/denylist.txt is named by the README and the contract (audit owns it) but is not in tcb/. audit treats an absent file as an empty list, so the denylist rule of R34 is silently off, and selftest's COPY_FILES copies a file that does not exist.
failures.likely_cause: The file is described as the owner's file and no builder was assigned to write a first version; audit.mjs line ~300 tolerates absence (fs.existsSync). Ship an explicit file (even comments only) so absence can be a refusal.
